text: The unloaded wage rate for a General and Operations Manager is $64.16. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). May 2018 National Industry-Specific Occupational Employment and Wage Estimates. NAICS 481000 - Air Transportation. OCC 11-1021 General and Operations Manager. Last modified March 30, 2018 (accessed June 11, 2019), https://www.bls.gov/oes/2017/May/naics3_481000.htm.  TSA calculates a load factor for a civilian employee working in Production, Transportation and Material Moving over the March 2018, June 2018, September 2018, and December 2018 quarters to account for non-wage compensation.  TSA calculates this factor by dividing the average total compensation ($28.92) by the average wage and salary component ($19.01), to get a load factor of 1.5217.  BLS.  Employer Costs for Employee Compensation - March 2018.  Table 1.  Employer costs per hour worked for employee compensation and costs as a percent of total compensation: civilian workers, by major occupational and industry group. Production, Transportation, and Material moving Occupational Group.  Last modified March 22, 2019 (accessed June 11, 2019), https://www.bls.gov/bls/news-release/ecec.htm#2018.  The fully-loaded wage rate is calculated by multiplying the unloaded wage rate by the load factor. $97.63= $64.16 x 1.5217.
